name: paper_figures_9_11
description: Prompts of Figures 9-11 of the TinyStories paper, recovered from the published PDF by layout-aware extraction. 'capability' and 'expected' are Team 32 grading criteria, not the paper's.

source.paper: TinyStories: How Small Can Language Models Be and Still Speak Coherent English?

notes: Quotes normalised from the PDF's U+201D to ASCII; text_pdf_raw keeps the original.
Hyphens inserted by the figure's line wrapping were removed.
The paper states no expected answers; it only colour-codes its own outputs.
'auto_accept' drives a conservative lexical screen, NOT human judgement; it is empty where substring matching cannot settle the answer.
